episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.plot: Alex si sottopone a difficili prove di ammissione per accedere al prestigioso liceo che aveva frequentato sua madre, un'astronauta morta improvvisamente otto mesi prima.

episodes.name: La sfida di inizio anno

episodes.name: Proiezione privata
episodes.plot: Brooke sorprende il suo ragazzo mentre fa qualcosa di sospetto sulla spiaggia. Jackie scopre il lato tenero di Max quando lui l'aiuta con i compiti.

episodes.name: Fumo nero
episodes.plot: Il segreto di Daniel viene svelato drammaticamente. Il mago degli scacchi Max incontra un degno avversario. L'amicizia tra Hayley e Leo subisce una svolta improvvisa.

episodes.name: La stoffa del capitano
episodes.plot: Hayley si arrabbia perché Leo evita di parlare di quello che è successo tra loro. Durante la lezione di educazione fisica, Max tenta di fare colpo su Emma.

episodes.name: Lezioni di nuoto
episodes.plot: I due candidati per il ruolo di capitano della squadra degli Eagles si affrontano in un dibattito. In classe gli studenti discutono su un ipotetico dilemma morale.

episodes.name: L'estranea
episodes.plot: Jackie dà consigli a Max su come invitare Emma a uscire con lui. Jason riceve una missione importante, ma rischiosa, da compiere durante il lancio del satellite.

translations.value: Jackie dà consigli a Max su come invitare Emma a uscire con lui. Jason riceve una missione importante, ma rischiosa, da compiere durante il lancio del satellite.

episodes.name: Steph
episodes.plot: Le indagini di Brooke la mettono in pericolo e le permettono di fare una scoperta. Sophie fa pulire lo spogliatoio ai ragazzi degli Eagles e un segreto è svelato.

episodes.plot: Alla Festa del raccolto, gli Eagles e i Ravens competono per vedere chi raccoglierà più fondi per una borsa di studio grazie al marketing e alla vendita di cupcake.

episodes.name: Grande Giove
episodes.plot: La lettera di Ryan rivela un segreto che ha nascosto al marito per anni. In seguito al rifiuto di Emma, Max porta Jackie al ballo di Halloween.

episodes.name: R.A.D.
episodes.plot: Hayley scopre chi ha fatto una visita a sorpresa a Leo. Emma affronta gli esiti della sua telefonata alla NASA. La gelosia di Daniel esplode al ballo della scuola.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: Flashbacks reveal a discovery that teenage Ryan made at the Greenhouse and an order given shortly before the Athena launch. Brooke is led into a trap.

translations.value: Flashbacks reveal a discovery that teenage Ryan made at the Greenhouse and an order given shortly before the Athena launch. Brooke is led into a trap.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: During a quiz game, know-it-all Aspen grates on Hayley's nerves and Brooke suffers a strange lapse in memory. Max misses Emma and tries calling her.

translations.value: During a quiz game, know-it-all Aspen grates on Hayley's nerves and Brooke suffers a strange lapse in memory. Max misses Emma and tries calling her.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: When Aspen's jealousy gets the better of her, Leo tells her they need to talk. Judy and Marcus trigger a test quake and get unexpected results.

translations.value: When Aspen's jealousy gets the better of her, Leo tells her they need to talk. Judy and Marcus trigger a test quake and get unexpected results.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: Under the sea, Hayley experiences something that changes how she thinks about her mom. Believing the world is ending, Parker blurts out a confession.

translations.value: Under the sea, Hayley experiences something that changes how she thinks about her mom. Believing the world is ending, Parker blurts out a confession.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: Sophie finds herself shunned by all the Eagles -- except for one. Daniel gets a hunch as to who might be influencing Brooke's recent behavior.

translations.value: Sophie finds herself shunned by all the Eagles -- except for one. Daniel gets a hunch as to who might be influencing Brooke's recent behavior.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: After catching his mom in lie, Daniel compares notes with Hayley. Aspen makes a slip that shocks Leo. Jackie is tricked into confessing a past misdeed.

translations.value: After catching his mom in lie, Daniel compares notes with Hayley. Aspen makes a slip that shocks Leo. Jackie is tricked into confessing a past misdeed.

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: Hayley and Daniel attempt to dehypnotize Brooke. Max and Jackie start to see a common thread behind all the strange events surrounding Emma.

translations.value: Hayley and Daniel attempt to dehypnotize Brooke. Max and Jackie start to see a common thread behind all the strange events surrounding Emma.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: Brooke tells Daniel and Hayley the last things she can remember before being hypnotized. Marcus makes a decision that stuns Louis and infuriates Judy.

translations.value: Brooke tells Daniel and Hayley the last things she can remember before being hypnotized. Marcus makes a decision that stuns Louis and infuriates Judy.

episodes.name: Episodio 9
episodes.plot: Leo awakens in the cave. During dinner with their parents, Brooke and Daniel carry out a plan to get Emma's white knight chess pieces from Jason.

translations.value: Leo awakens in the cave. During dinner with their parents, Brooke and Daniel carry out a plan to get Emma's white knight chess pieces from Jason.

episodes.name: Episodio 10
episodes.plot: When Hayley tells her brother and friends the big news, they argue over whether to take action. Max and Jackie are caught trying to contact Emma.

episodes.name: Episodio 11
episodes.plot: While Daniel and Alex stall for time at the basketball game, Hayley sneaks into the cave and Max gets help from an unexpected ally.

translations.value: While Daniel and Alex stall for time at the basketball game, Hayley sneaks into the cave and Max gets help from an unexpected ally.

episodes.name: Episodio 12
episodes.plot: As time runs out on a bomb designed to destroy the cave and the rest of the Greenhouse, the students in the gym must get past police to make a rescue.

translations.value: As time runs out on a bomb designed to destroy the cave and the rest of the Greenhouse, the students in the gym must get past police to make a rescue.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: When the Eagles and Ravens start getting too friendly, the headmaster sends them on a grueling two-day hike devised to reignite their competitive fire

translations.value: When the Eagles and Ravens start getting too friendly, the headmaster sends them on a grueling two-day hike devised to reignite their competitive fire

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: The fallout from the hike reverberates inside and outside the school, leading to hard questions -- and a difficult decision.

translations.value: The fallout from the hike reverberates inside and outside the school, leading to hard questions -- and a difficult decision.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: Brooke scrambles to keep a secret from Alex during an upheaval at the Greenhouse. Sophie's past choices threaten her current status at the school.

translations.value: Brooke scrambles to keep a secret from Alex during an upheaval at the Greenhouse. Sophie's past choices threaten her current status at the school.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: As a sinister plot targeting the school unfolds, Hayley embraces her new lifestyle, annoying Leo, while Brooke argues with Alex about her brother.

translations.value: As a sinister plot targeting the school unfolds, Hayley embraces her new lifestyle, annoying Leo, while Brooke argues with Alex about her brother.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: A remarkable gift from Ryan boosts the Ravens' flagging spirits. Becca smothers Leo with attention. Brooke makes an impulsive, ill-timed decision.

translations.value: A remarkable gift from Ryan boosts the Ravens' flagging spirits. Becca smothers Leo with attention. Brooke makes an impulsive, ill-timed decision.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Members of the Eagles and Ravens team up on a risky mission to find a valuable chunk of magnetite. A disheartened Brooke looks to make a fresh start.

translations.value: Members of the Eagles and Ravens team up on a risky mission to find a valuable chunk of magnetite. A disheartened Brooke looks to make a fresh start.

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: While the Eagles and Ravens compete in a capture-the-flag challenge, Enzo receives a mysterious offer that's too lucrative for him to question.

translations.value: While the Eagles and Ravens compete in a capture-the-flag challenge, Enzo receives a mysterious offer that's too lucrative for him to question.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: Hayley's determination to get to the bottom of an annoying beeping noise unwittingly sets a deadly chain of events into motion.

translations.value: Hayley's determination to get to the bottom of an annoying beeping noise unwittingly sets a deadly chain of events into motion.

episodes.name: Rock by Rock
episodes.plot: After an explosion rocks the school, one student hopes for a rescue while another one faces a threat from a mysterious virus.

translations.value: After an explosion rocks the school, one student hopes for a rescue while another one faces a threat from a mysterious virus.

episodes.name: The Quick One
episodes.plot: As Hayley considers a risky way to save her classmate, the Eagles and the Ravens have a theory about the mystery virus.

translations.value: As Hayley considers a risky way to save her classmate, the Eagles and the Ravens have a theory about the mystery virus.

episodes.name: A Not Totally Bad Person
episodes.plot: Leo's setback creates tension between Hayley and Daniel. Meanwhile, an FBI investigation results in several major revelations.

translations.value: Leo's setback creates tension between Hayley and Daniel. Meanwhile, an FBI investigation results in several major revelations.

episodes.name: Gummy Bears
episodes.plot: Trusted with personal information, Becca and Daniel each battle their true emotions. A schedule change poses a serious problem for a shadowy enemy.

translations.value: Trusted with personal information, Becca and Daniel each battle their true emotions. A schedule change poses a serious problem for a shadowy enemy.

episodes.name: Cortinarius Orellanus
episodes.plot: The shadowy enemy puts a sinister plan in motion. Later, Sophie investigates questionable news while Daniel debates making a confession.

translations.value: The shadowy enemy puts a sinister plan in motion. Later, Sophie investigates questionable news while Daniel debates making a confession.

episodes.name: Hundred Percent
episodes.plot: As the Eagles and the Ravens examine evidence from an attack, a suspicious text from Leo leads them all to a shocking discovery.

translations.value: As the Eagles and the Ravens examine evidence from an attack, a suspicious text from Leo leads them all to a shocking discovery.

episodes.name: Room 205
episodes.plot: As Hayley, Daniel and Leo edge closer to learning the truth behind the mystery virus, their real feelings about each other finally come out.

translations.value: As Hayley, Daniel and Leo edge closer to learning the truth behind the mystery virus, their real feelings about each other finally come out.

episodes.name: The Client
episodes.plot: Time is ticking as the shadowy figure makes a frightening ultimatum. Can the Eagles and the Ravens intervene in time to save the world?

translations.overview: Due fratelli adolescenti, Hayley e Alex, sono ammessi in un collegio d'élite, dove scoprono rivalità, amore e un mistero legato alla recente scomparsa della madre.
When teen siblings Hayley and Alex enter an elite boarding school, they find rivalry, romance and a mystery related to the recent loss of their mom.
